hints.title: Division by Four Intervals
hints.text: Every integer x in [4^(i-1), 4^i - 1] requires exactly i divisions by 4 to reduce to zero.

hints.title: Sum Operations over Buckets
hints.text: Count how many numbers in [l, r] fall into each power-of-four bracket and multiply by their division requirement.

hints.title: Pairwise Operation Sharing
hints.text: Since each operation divides two elements at once, the total operations needed for a range is ceil(total_divisions / 2).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each query evaluates about 15 power-of-four intervals in constant space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through every number up to 10^9 times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Evaluating intervals analytically uses constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Group numbers by powers of 4 to compute division counts in logarithmic steps.
